home.subtitle: Paid Talent connects skilled workers with recruiters looking for top talent. Create your profile or start recruiting today.
home.step1Body: Workers build detailed profiles showcasing skills, experience, and availability.
home.step2Body: Recruiters search and filter to find the perfect candidates for their needs.
home.step3Body: Recruiters message Top Talent in chat. Contact details stay private until talent choose to share them.
home.openAccessBody: Top Talent badges and ranking stay visible so recruiters can see the most in-demand workers. Premium messaging and higher limits are currently open without a subscription.
home.subscribeBody: Message Top Talent, get higher daily contact-request limits, priority in their inbox with a Verified Pro badge, and a longer opening message.

footer.tagline: Connecting workers with recruiters. Find your next opportunity.

howItWorksPage.title: How It Works
howItWorksPage.subtitle: Paid Talent connects verified workers with venues looking to hire.
howItWorksPage.talentStep1Body: Build a profile with your skills, availability, and clear photos so venues can see who you are.
howItWorksPage.talentStep2Body: Complete identity and liveness checks so recruiters know you are a real, verified person.
howItWorksPage.talentStep3Body: When interested, venues message you in chat. Your LINE, WhatsApp, and phone stay private until you choose to share them.
howItWorksPage.recruiterStep1Body: Set up your venue details so workers know who is reaching out.
howItWorksPage.recruiterStep2Body: Browse and filter verified workers that match your roles, location, and needs.
howItWorksPage.recruiterStep3Body: Express "I'm interested" and continue in chat. Talent share their LINE or number only when they choose to.

topTalentPage.title: Top Talent
topTalentPage.subtitle: Subscription-gated messaging and priority for top-ranked verified workers.
topTalentPage.whatItIsBody: Top Talent highlights the highest-ranked verified workers on Paid Talent. A Top Talent subscription or 7-day pass lets recruiters message these profiles, with higher limits, inbox priority, a Verified Pro badge, and a longer opener with an opening attached. Contact details stay private until talent share them in chat.
topTalentPage.whoItsForBody: Venues and recruiters who want faster access to standout, verified talent — and workers who want to be discovered by serious hiring venues.
topTalentPage.howAccessBody: Top Talent badges and ranking stay visible to recruiters. Messaging Top Talent, higher contact-request limits, and inbox priority require a verified recruiter with a subscription or pass (unless the platform is temporarily in open-access mode). LINE, WhatsApp, and phone are never shown on profiles.
topTalentPage.verifyRequiredNote: Verify your identity and venue before you can upgrade to Top Talent.
topTalentPage.openAccessNote: Premium Top Talent messaging and limits are currently free for all recruiters while we're in beta. Contact details remain private.
topTalentPage.signedInWorkerNote: You're signed in as talent. Switch to a recruiter account to subscribe to Top Talent access.

privacyPage.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPage.intro: This draft summarizes how Paid Talent intends to handle personal data. It is not final legal advice and will be updated before launch.
privacyPage.whoWeAreBody: TODO: Legal entity name, registered address, and contact details for the data controller.
privacyPage.dataCollectedBody: Account details (such as email and role), profile information, photos, optional private contact methods you save for later sharing in chat (LINE, WhatsApp, phone), job preferences, and verification materials including government ID images and liveness video recordings used to confirm you are a real person.
privacyPage.howWeUseBody: We use this data to operate the marketplace, verify workers, show profiles to recruiters, process subscriptions, prevent fraud and abuse, and improve the product.
privacyPage.retentionBody: TODO: Confirm retention periods for account data, ID documents, and liveness videos. Verification media is kept only as long as needed for review, dispute handling, and security, then deleted or anonymized according to policy.
privacyPage.sharingBody: We share data with service providers that help us run hosting, storage, email, and payments. Recruiters see profile information you publish. Your LINE, WhatsApp, and phone are never shown on your public profile; you share them only in chat when you choose. We do not sell personal data.
privacyPage.yourRightsBody: TODO: Describe applicable rights (access, correction, deletion, objection) and how to exercise them under relevant law.
privacyPage.contactBody: TODO: Privacy contact email and mailing address for data requests.

termsPage.title: Terms of Service
termsPage.intro: These draft terms outline intended rules for using Paid Talent. They are not final and will be reviewed before launch.
termsPage.acceptanceBody: By creating an account or using Paid Talent, you agree to these terms and our Privacy Policy once they are finalized.
termsPage.eligibilityBody: You must be 20 years of age or older to use Paid Talent. Accounts may require age and identity verification.
termsPage.accountsBody: You are responsible for activity on your account. Workers and recruiters have different features; misuse, impersonation, or fake verification may lead to suspension or bans.
termsPage.marketplaceBody: Paid Talent helps venues discover talent. Hiring decisions, pay, and work arrangements happen directly between users. Do not post unlawful, harmful, or misleading content.
termsPage.subscriptionsBody: Some recruiter features — including messaging Top Talent, higher contact-request limits, and inbox priority — may require a paid subscription. Worker contact details are never sold or unlocked via subscription. Billing terms will be confirmed with the payment provider.
termsPage.liabilityBody: TODO: Finalize limitation of liability, disclaimer, and governing-law language with counsel.
termsPage.contactBody: TODO: Legal entity name and contact email for terms questions.
